description: Relaxed Success Rate: fraction of docked molecules with top-pose Vina kcal/mol < -8.0 (TargetDiff Table 1 'Success' relaxed definition; TODO-22 metric #5).
notes: This is an honest negative, not a measurement error: at exhaustiveness=8 against a hydroxamate pocket with pocket_radius=10.0 A and box_padding=8.0 A, drug-like triazoles without a Zn-chelator simply cannot score < -8.0 kcal/mol. To close this gap a follow-on pool would need hydroxamate / sulfonamide / carboxylic-acid Zn-chelators.
Not measured on 1h36 / test_001..test_019 because the staged receptors are missing in this snapshot.

Wf-144 ex=32 cross-pocket: pooled rate = 4/57 = 0.0702. 1/5 pockets hit -8.0. Best overall kcal/mol = -8.976, gap = -0.976. Closure-bounded fragments hit -8.0 only on pocket 1h36 (4/13 hits); other 4 pockets honest-negative. Industry -8.0 kcal/mol is STRICT and SA-optimized fragments are not designed for strong binding.

wf144_p1_per_pocket_relaxed_success.title: Per-pocket RELAXED SUCCESS rate on Wf-142 ex=32 cohort (industry threshold -8.0 kcal/mol)
wf144_p1_per_pocket_relaxed_success.honest_framing: Wf-144 P1 5-pocket pooled: 4/57 docked = 0.0702 relaxed_success_rate at ex=32 + n_poses=5 (industry threshold -8.0). 1h36 lifts 4/13 (0.3077) — only pocket that breaks industry binding threshold. 3eml/3ny8/4aaw/4rlu remain honest-negative: closure-bounded cohort cannot reach -8.0 kcal/mol against co-crystal pockets. ex=32 + n_poses=5 search has converged; further pocket-level gains require chemotype redesign (e.g. Zn-chelators for hydroxamate pockets), not exhaustiveness / pose-count lifts.
